_instructions: HUONG DAN TICH HOP MCP VAO ANTIGRAVITY IDE:
1. Sao chep noi dung file nay vao file cau hinh MCP global: ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (hoac de nguyen tai .agents/mcp_config.json khi su dung plugin mode).
2. Trong Antigravity IDE, mo menu: Additional Options (...) > MCP Servers de kiem tra trang thai ket noi (Connected).
3. Khi ket noi thanh cong, cac tools tu database (read_query, execute_query, list_tables, describe_table) se tu dong xuat hien trong toolset cua Subagents 1-data-architect va 5-content-publisher.
